name: Miyan Karkashi (Nigerian Sesame Leaf Soup)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup karkashi leaves, either fresh or dried and ground

steps: Grind the karkashi leaves to a paste.
Bring the water to boil in a pot, and stir in the fermented locust beans.
Add the fish and meat, and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Add the karkashi leaf paste along with the potash. Stir, and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the seasoning cube. Continue stirring with a whisk for 3 minutes until the mixture is smooth.
Serve the soup with tuwo masara, tuwo dawa, tuwo alkama, or tuwo shinkafa.
